name: alakazam_ml_v5
model: LightGBM candidate ranker distilled to pure Python trees
model_scope: Shadow-scored ACTIVE MAIN ranking over guarded bench, evolution, and attack candidates. Deterministic fallback remains authoritative unless ALAKAZAM_ML_ENABLE_OVERRIDE=1 is explicitly set for an experiment.
deck_policy: 60-card revision: 3 Dunsparce / 3 Dudunsparce, 3 basic Psychic, Fezandipiti ex as persistent Bench draw support, Genesect + Lucky Helmet, Max Rod ACE, no Boss/Shaymin/Psyduck.

rules: replace Psyduck with a third basic Psychic Energy
bench Fezandipiti ex early when it does not consume a required core slot or worsen the current KO clock
use Fezandipiti ex only as post-KO Bench draw support; never pre-fuel or voluntarily promote it
bench Genesect only when Lucky Helmet is already in hand and the core Bench reserve remains available
play Nighttime Mine only when its additional Colorless tax immediately stops the opposing Active Tera attack
preserve v3-like attack tempo, current KO, and practical hit-count clock
use the self-contained v3 policy as the authoritative general fallback
